claim: The first solo native sweep converted six load/runtime failures into source-bound compatibility fixes, and the replacement 41-map candidate closes every presently known script and skeleton-family dependency without mixing the solo and co-op runtime trees.

native_failure_families.resolution: retain every Xbox-only principal map script and omit only exact scripts already compiled by stock PC doom_main

native_failure_families.failure: the absent glassbreak_idle member invalidated the complete Pinky modelDef
native_failure_families.resolution: remove only the absent idle member while retaining the shipped glassbreak cinematic

native_failure_families.failure: the inherited PC scientist gib skeleton had a different joint count
native_failure_families.resolution: restore the stock PC lantern-scientist gib model selected by the corresponding PC definition

native_failure_families.failure: the Xbox jumpsuit-zombie definition selected an original-Xbox mesh/animation family absent from PC
native_failure_families.resolution: ship the complete 15-file authenticated Xbox family only in maps that instantiate it

native_failure_families.failure: the PC archives omit the map's 122-joint scientist-pull mesh and animations
native_failure_families.resolution: ship the recovered mesh and both matching 122-joint animations as one family

native_failure_families.failure: the Xbox definition selected a 50-joint Revenant-intro mesh while the PC PK4 supplied incompatible 109/110-joint animations
native_failure_families.resolution: ship the recovered 50-joint mesh and both matching Xbox cinematic animations as one family

native_failure_families.failure: the Xbox commando definition references head_butt.md5anim, absent from PC and incompatible in raw 50-joint form with the stock 63-joint PC mesh
native_failure_families.resolution: reuse the audited name-matched 50-to-63-joint retarget already accepted by the co-op reconstruction

native_failure_families.failure: the PC archives omit the Xbox-selected hazmat mesh, bind pose and three 48-joint cinematics
native_failure_families.resolution: ship all five recovered 48-joint files as one map-scoped family

limits: The replacement tree has not yet completed a clean 41-map 60-second native sweep.
Dedicated-host loading is crash and spawn evidence, not visual, audio, gameplay or transition-fidelity acceptance.
The 20-map co-op replacement sweep remains required after solo is clean.
